n551596c9f4.headline: Agricultural campaign: An exceptional cereal harvest of 98.2 million quintals expected
n551596c9f4.summary: Morocco anticipates a cereal production of 98.2 million quintals this agricultural campaign, a 3% increase from last year.
n551596c9f4.why: Agricultural output impacts food supply, commodity prices, and rural economies, influencing inflation and trade balances in Morocco.
